title: Nasruddin and the Jug

full_text:
Before sending his young son to fetch water from the distant spring, Nasruddin gave the boy a gentle slap across the cheek: "Mind you do not drop the clay jug!"

A neighbor protested: "Mulla, why do you strike the child before he has done anything wrong?"

Nasruddin replied: "You fool! What good would it do to strike him after the jug is already broken on the rocks? The lesson must be taught while the jug is still whole!"
moral: Warning before the catastrophe is wise; crying over broken shards is useless.
